description: What the Michigan MDHHS List of Sanctioned Providers covers and how current it is: total rows, counts by sanction source (MDHHS, MDHHS-OIG, LARA, DCH, HHS), individuals vs businesses, how many carry an NPI, license number or reason, oldest and newest sanction date, and the list's own publication date. Use to check the screening data is fresh enough before a compliance decision. Pass year (e.g. 2025) or start_date/end_date to instead COUNT how many sanctions have a sanction date in that year or range, counted over the whole list rather than a page, split by sanction source. The response names the date field counted (sanction_date, the first Sanction Date column, never the second date). Sourced from MDHHS, keyless.
